supersedes: audits/api-webhooks-shape-snapshot-2026-07-25.json (additive — old file retained; only quarantine_expires_at is new, every prior key is byte-unchanged)
scope: OWNER-SCOPED (API-key authenticated; not a public/landing surface). PII-free; no owner_key/secret in the list response.
naming_law: Owner-visible lifecycle uses neutral ops terms (delivery_state, quarantined, disabled). Public event fields use price_at_call / call, never price_at_signal / signal. No outcome_* / pfe_* / mae_* ever (Data Integrity).

new_in_this_wave.quarantine_expires_at: ALWAYS present — epoch seconds at which a quarantined subscription expires to disabled(quarantine_expired), else null. Non-null ONLY while delivery_state='quarantined'; a disabled sub retains quarantined_at but its deadline has already passed, so echoing one would mislead. Derived from quarantineExpiresAt(quarantined_at, tier) in src/lib/webhook-quarantine-policy.ts — never a literal, and never a hardcoded '7 days'.

allowed_keys: secret (POST create only, includeSecret=true — returned ONCE)

lifecycle_contract.states: active → (transient failures) → degraded → (>= WEBHOOK_QUARANTINE_AFTER_FAILURES) → quarantined → (health-probe 2xx) → active | (quarantineMaxSecFor(tier) elapsed with no recovery) → disabled(quarantine_expired)
lifecycle_contract.quarantine_window: TIER-DIFFERENTIATED since this wave (D2). Paid tiers [starter, pro, enterprise, x402] → 30d (2592000s); free / internal / null / unrecognised → 7d (604800s), the incumbent. The fallback is current behaviour, never a silent widening: an unknown tier can never buy a longer window. ONE derivation: quarantineMaxSecFor(tier).
lifecycle_contract.window_override: WEBHOOK_QUARANTINE_MAX_SEC, when a valid POSITIVE decimal integer, wins for EVERY tier — the single-env-var rollback lever to pre-wave uniform behaviour. Garbage / zero / negative / non-decimal (0x10, 0b11, 0o17) are REJECTED by a strict decimal gate before Number(), so a hex string can never install a 16-second window.
lifecycle_contract.permanent: http_410 → disabled(permanent_http_410) immediately (the ONLY instant hard-disable).
lifecycle_contract.projection: active is derived from delivery_state in the SAME write (single-derivation); the enqueue `WHERE active` hot-path is byte-unchanged.
lifecycle_contract.flag: new behavior gated WEBHOOK_AUTO_RECOVERY_ENABLED (default-on when WEBHOOK_DELIVERY_ENABLED=true; flip 0 = legacy one-way disable, no delivery_state transitions, no sweep).

cache_contract.reason: Owner-scoped, API-key authenticated, reflects live lifecycle state; must never be shared across callers or served stale.

consumers: webhook-delivery-canary.py (reads delivery_state='disabled' → TERMINAL-DISABLE page; quarantined/degraded = silent)
the in-process health-probe sweep (getQuarantinedDue → probe → auto-resume/back-off/expire)
src/lib/subscriber-notify.ts (CH4) — the quarantined-notification template interpolates the SAME quarantineExpiresAt value the owner sees here
drift_check_command: curl -s https://api.algovault.com/api/webhooks -H 'Authorization: Bearer <key>' | jq '.subscriptions[0] | keys'  # expect delivery_state AND quarantine_expires_at present; NO outcome_*/pfe_*/mae_* keys
